body:
GoogleAuthHandler now sets an HttpOnly iduna_session cookie alongside its bearer JSON response; RefreshHandler accepts/refreshes that cookie. Prerequisite for gating the planned Jupyter/SARENA notebook portal behind real IDUNA login (cookie survives plain browser nav + nginx auth_request, unlike a bearer token). Commit a02bb87.

⚓ ☃
title: Cookie-capable Google SSO + refresh sync (notebook portal auth foundation)
